title: Catalan Opening: Closed
line: Black keeps its center pawn, and White gets the king's pawn ready to push and take more space.

steps.text: The Catalan, and this time Black keeps its pawn on d5.
Bring the knight out, ready to castle.
Castle, to get your king to safety.
steps.after: Black's bishop on c8 is shut in behind its own pawns.

steps.text: Bring the queen out. It guards the pawn on c4 and backs up a pawn push to e4.
Bring the other knight out. It guards e4 too.
Push the pawn in front of your king two squares. White takes more of the center.
Push it on. It takes space and drives the knight back.
steps.after: Black's pieces have little room, and White can turn to the king's side.

summary: When Black keeps its center pawn, White brings the queen and a knight behind the king's pawn and pushes it.
